answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a deposit before it can vote or earn, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand deposits. Reputation then grows like a vine, slowly and only along verified work, so a fresh sybil starts near zero and cannot reach the zenith of influence quickly. Every signed action, like ink from a quill, is logged on-ledger, and provable misbehavior slashes the stake.
